solverType.description: Optional CAPTCHA solver mode. Set to visual to use the visual reCAPTCHA solver.

persistChanges.description: Whether profile changes should be persisted after the session ends.

persistNetworkCache.description: Whether network cache should be persisted into the profile.

enabled.description: Whether proxying should be active for the running session.

staticIpId.description: Static IP allocation to use when enabling a static IP proxy.

enabled.description: Whether automatic CAPTCHA solving should be enabled for this running session.

solverType.description: Optional CAPTCHA solver mode. Set to visual to use the visual reCAPTCHA solver.
Optional CAPTCHA solver mode. Set to visual to use the visual reCAPTCHA solver.

ProxyState.description: Optional state code for proxies to US states. Is mutually exclusive with proxyCity. Takes in two letter state code.

screenshotOptions.description: Options for the screenshot. Both `fullPage` and `cropToContent` cannot be true at the same time.

cropToContent.description: Automatically adjusts the screenshot height to match the page's actual content. If the page is shorter than the viewport, the screenshot is trimmed to remove any empty space below the content. If the page is taller than the viewport, the screenshot is cropped to the height of the viewport.

cropToContentMaxHeight.description: The maximum height of the screenshot when `cropToContent` is true. Overrides the height set in the `screen` configuration.

cropToContentMinHeight.description: The minimum height of the screenshot when `cropToContent` is true. Overrides the height set in the `screen` configuration.

persistNetworkCache.description: When persisting profile changes, also persist the browser's network cache (HTTP cache).

proxyCity.description: Desired Country. Is mutually exclusive with proxyState. Some cities might not be supported, so before using a new city, we recommend trying it out

solverType.description: Optional CAPTCHA solver mode. Set to visual to use the visual reCAPTCHA solver.

enableVideoWebRecording.description: enableWebRecording must also be true for this to work

prompt.description: Natural language prompt describing what data to extract. If only prompt is provided, a schema is auto-generated from it. If both prompt and schema are provided, the schema defines the output structure while the prompt provides additional guidance for the extraction.

BrandingProfile.description: Visual brand profile extracted via DOM analysis + LLM enhancement. All fields optional; the server may return a partial profile when the LLM refuses or fails.

colorScheme.description: Page color scheme. Common values: light, dark.

colors.description: Color role assignments. Common keys: primary, secondary, accent, background, textPrimary, textSecondary, link.

typography.description: Font families, stacks, and sizes. Keys: fontFamilies, fontStacks, fontSizes, lineHeights, fontWeights.

spacing.description: Spacing scale. Common keys: baseUnit, borderRadius, padding, margins, gridGutter.

components.description: Per-component style dictionaries. Common keys: buttonPrimary, buttonSecondary, input. Each value has background, textColor, borderColor, borderRadius, borderRadiusCorners, shadow.

images.description: Brand images. Common keys: logo, logoHref, logoAlt, favicon, ogImage.

personality.description: Brand personality. Common keys: tone, energy, targetAudience.

designSystem.description: Detected design system. Common keys: framework, componentLibrary.

confidence.description: Confidence scores (0-1). Common keys: buttons, colors, overall.

post.description: X402 payment endpoint. First request returns 402 with payment requirements. Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header containing cryptographic proof to get the actual data. See https://x402.gitbook.io/x402 for protocol details.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64-encoded JSON containing payment proof (x402Version, resource, accepted payment method, and cryptographic payload with signature and payer address)

402.description: Payment Required - returned on first request without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded JSON containing X402 payment requirements (x402Version, resource info, and array of accepted payment methods with network, asset, amount, payTo address, and timeout)
